mapper.sql: a.admission_policy_id, a.admission_policy_version, a.borrowing_policy_id, a.borrowing_policy_version, a.id, a.application_no, a.applicant_member_id, a.target_member_id, a.applicant_member_type, a.applicant_role_id, a.application_type, a.status, a.reason, a.expected_member_version, a.expected_profile_version, a.reviewer_member_id, a.reviewer_role_id, a.decision, a.decision_reason, a.decided_at, a.cancelled_at, a.expires_at, a.version, a.created_at, a.updated_at, r.current_qualification_status, r.current_accepted_rule_version, r.accepted_rule_version, r.current_max_borrow_count, r.requested_max_borrow_count, r.quota_duration_days, e.current_department_id, e.requested_department_id, e.current_position_name, e.requested_position_name, e.current_employment_status, e.requested_employment_action, e.current_role_id, e.requested_role_id, coalesce(r.current_account_status, e.current_account_status) as current_account_status, coalesce(r.requested_account_action, e.requested_account_action) as requested_account_action, e.current_hired_on, e.current_left_on
mapper.insert: insert into member_change_application (admission_policy_id, admission_policy_version, borrowing_policy_id, borrowing_policy_version, application_no, applicant_member_id, target_member_id, applicant_member_type, applicant_role_id, application_type, status, reason, expected_member_version, expected_profile_version, expires_at, version, created_at, updated_at) values (#{application.admissionPolicyId}, #{application.admissionPolicyVersion}, #{application.borrowingPolicyId}, #{application.borrowingPolicyVersion}, #{application.applicationNo}, #{application.applicantMemberId}, #{application.targetMemberId}, #{application.applicantMemberType}, #{application.applicantRoleId}, #{application.applicationType}, #{application.status}, #{application.reason}, #{application.expectedMemberVersion}, #{application.expectedProfileVersion}, #{application.expiresAt}, 0, current_timestamp, current_timestamp)

insert into reader_change_application (application_id, current_qualification_status, current_accepted_rule_version, accepted_rule_version, current_max_borrow_count, requested_max_borrow_count, quota_duration_days, current_account_status, requested_account_action) values (#{application.id}, #{application.currentQualificationStatus}, #{application.currentAcceptedRuleVersion}, #{application.acceptedRuleVersion}, #{application.currentMaxBorrowCount}, #{application.requestedMaxBorrowCount}, #{application.quotaDurationDays}, #{application.currentAccountStatus}, #{application.requestedAccountAction})

insert into employee_change_application (application_id, current_department_id, requested_department_id, current_position_name, requested_position_name, current_employment_status, requested_employment_action, current_role_id, requested_role_id, current_account_status, requested_account_action, current_hired_on, current_left_on) values (#{application.id}, #{application.currentDepartmentId}, #{application.requestedDepartmentId}, #{application.currentPositionName}, #{application.requestedPositionName}, #{application.currentEmploymentStatus}, #{application.requestedEmploymentAction}, #{application.currentRoleId}, #{application.requestedRoleId}, #{application.currentAccountStatus}, #{application.requestedAccountAction}, #{application.currentHiredOn}, #{application.currentLeftOn})
mapper.select: select id from member where id = #{memberId} for update
select from member_change_application a left join reader_change_application r on r.application_id = a.id left join employee_change_application e on e.application_id = a.id where a.id = #{id}

select from member_change_application a left join reader_change_application r on r.application_id = a.id left join employee_change_application e on e.application_id = a.id where a.id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update member set qualification_status = #{status}, version = version + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp(3) where id = #{memberId} and qualification_status = 'PENDING' and version = #{expectedVersion}

update member_change_application set status = #{status}, decision = #{decision}, decision_reason = #{reason}, reviewer_member_id = #{reviewerMemberId}, reviewer_role_id = #{reviewerRoleId}, decided_at = current_timestamp, version = version + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING' and version = #{expectedVersion} and (expires_at is null or expires_at > #{now})

update member
set temporary_borrow_limit = #{borrowLimit}, temporary_quota_expires_at = #{expiresAt},
set permanent_borrow_limit = #{borrowLimit}, temporary_borrow_limit = null, temporary_quota_expires_at = null,
version = version + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{memberId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and borrowed_book_count <= #{borrowLimit}
update member set role_id = #{roleId}, version = version + 1, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{memberId} and member_type = 'EMPLOYEE' and version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select count(*) from department where id = #{departmentId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
select count(*) from employee_profile where member_id = #{memberId}
select version from employee_profile where member_id = #{memberId}
